prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of three separate compact clusters, each made of three thin six-sided hexagon tiles, one cluster in wood, one in ceramic and one in brushed steel, on one pale grid sheet with wide open space between the clusters, all three clusters inside the middle of the frame. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small separate six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass resting on top of the steel cluster. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
